content_blocks.text: Predict the output type and value, run a minimal SELECT expression, and test a NULL or boundary input. Write down the expected result before running the snippet. Compare actual output with the reference, then try one normal case and one edge case.

content_blocks.code: SELECT CONCAT(TRIM('  CodeLeaf  '), ' SQL') AS label, CHAR_LENGTH('MySQL') AS char_count, REPLACE('read-only', '-', ' ') AS phrase;
content_blocks.expected_output: One row: label = CodeLeaf SQL, char_count = 5, phrase = read only.
